name: media
description: Governed media upload and preview. Bytes live in a Unity Catalog Volume via the Files plugin (on-behalf-of-user); metadata lives in the app-owned Lakebase media.media_assets table.

required.description: Unity Catalog volume for uploaded bytes and thumbnails, accessed via the Files plugin on-behalf-of-user. Each end user needs READ VOLUME and WRITE VOLUME.
Lakebase Postgres database that stores the app-owned media.media_assets metadata table. The app service principal needs CAN_CONNECT_AND_CREATE to create the schema and table.

endpointPath.description: Lakebase endpoint resource name (wired in app.yaml via valueFrom: postgres).

author: Databricks
onSetupMessage: Wire a UC Volume (app.yaml valueFrom: files) and Lakebase (valueFrom: postgres). Add app-level user_api_scopes: [files.files]. Grant the app service principal Lakebase CAN_CONNECT_AND_CREATE, and grant each end user UC READ VOLUME + WRITE VOLUME on the volume (Files access is on-behalf-of-user).
